Her robot studies cover human-like cross.en: Her robot studies cover human-like crossmodal social attention on iCub, gaze and facial expressions in cooperation, and social mirroring with humanoid robots. With HRI-Free collaborators, she develops cognitive robotic simulations to evaluate embodied social attention models. Her human-AI work examines emotion-aware conversational agents and role-swapping in voice interaction.
Her robot studies cover human-like cross.zh: 她研究 iCub 上类人的跨模态社会注意机制、注视与面部表情对合作的影响，以及人形机器人的社会镜像行为。她与 HRI-Free 合作者开发认知机器人仿真，用于评估具身社会注意模型；在人与人工智能交互方面，她研究情绪感知对话智能体及语音交互中的角色互换。
